description: Live prices from UK supermarkets: Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Morrisons. Searches one store by keyword and returns products with price in GBP, was-price, unit price, promotion, pack size and link (Tesco and Asda prices come from the stores' own Google Shopping listings). Suited to UK grocery price comparison. $0.01 per call, up to 50 products.

onlySpecials.description: Only products on offer (skipped products are not returned).
